To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
cement modification of clay improves the static and cyclic shear behavior of the clay.
the unconfined compressive strength of the cement modified soil increases with increasing cement content and curing time.
the strength and stiffness of the soil cement mixture increases with increase in cement content and curing time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the static and dynamic properties of cement modified soils.
the static and dynamic properties of cement modified Kaolin clay.
the study of the effect of cement and curing on the strength, stiffness and pore pressure behavior of compacted soil cement mixtures under static and cyclic loads.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the unconfined compressive strengths, modulus of elasticities, drained and und rained shear strength parameters and stress-strain behavior of the compacted soil cement samples were found to increase with the increase in curing time and cement content.
the cement content and curing time play a significant role on the static and dynamic properties of the soil cement mixes.
the unconfined compressive strength of cement modified clays increases with increase in the amount of cement and curing days.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the cement modified clay showed significant increase in the static and dynamic strength properties as the curing time was increased and the cement proportion was increased.
the unconfined compressive strengths and shear strength parameters increase with the increase of curing time.
the unconfined compressive strengths, modulus of elasticities, shear strengths and pore pressure parameters were increased with increasing cement content.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cement content of 5% and 6% and the curing time of 7 days are optimum to achieve the best performance in terms of strength parameters, modulus of elasticity and stress strain behavior.
the soil cement mix has higher shear strength and stiffness than the natural clay.
cement modification of clay soils can improve the strength, stiffness, and pore pressure behavior of the soil.
